This plot is my smaller one, and I am growing something other than my main cereal here. I have some schooling and I own the land, but fertilizer is expensive and I would rather save it for my teff and maize plots where it gives the best return. I will put manure from my animals on this plot instead — it costs me nothing and keeps the soil in good condition. I will use my own seed saved from last year, and my family will do most of the work, though I may pay a few neighbors to help at weeding and harvest time.
